# The SDET Architect — Field Guide

📖 **Live:** https://akc031185.github.io/sdet-architect/

Plate 45 of the field guide, with its own home: what the agent does, how it parses any legacy test estate into one Playwright architecture (real code behind every step), and how to run it.

**This site is generated. Do not edit it here.** The source, the code and the tests live in
[akc031185/forward-qa-agents](https://github.com/akc031185/forward-qa-agents):

```
_build/sites/sdet/           site.json, categories.json, content/
_build/author/plates.mjs     the plate text, code slices and annotations
_build/author/diagrams.mjs   the inline SVG figures
npm run catalog:author       regenerates this folder
```
